title: Jobs
description: The offline work that builds each persona's knowledge. A job keeps running when you close this page.
empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.body: They appear here when you index facts or add videos in a persona's studio.
about.pipeline: Downloads, transcribes, refines and indexes her videos. Each step skips what's already done.
about.download: Downloads the audio of her videos with yt-dlp.
about.expand: Reads a playlist, channel or series link and lists the videos in it.
about.transcribe: Turns a video's audio into a transcript with Soniox.
about.refine: Cleans up her transcripts with the refine model.
about.ingest-streams: Indexes her stream transcripts, so she can recall past broadcasts.
about.ingest-facts: Indexes her fact files: what she knows about herself.
about.build-stream-catalog: Builds the date-by-date overview of her broadcasts from the transcripts.
about.plan: Works out what the video pipeline would do and what it would cost, without running it.
log.title: Log
log.description: What the job reported, newest at the bottom.
stderr.title: Technical log
stderr.description: What the command printed. Its end usually says why a job stopped.
entries.title: Videos found ({count})
notFound.title: There is no such job
cancel.title: Cancel this job?
cancel.body: What it already finished is kept, so resuming it later picks up where it stopped.
meta.unpriced: Part of the cost couldn't be priced.
interrupted.title: Eidolon stopped while this job ran
interrupted.body: Resume runs it again, and every stage skips the work it already finished.
cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.body: Resume runs it again, and every stage skips the work it already finished.
resumeNote: Resume runs it again, and every stage skips the work it already finished.
crashed.title: This job stopped without finishing
crashed.body: It ended before reporting a result. The end of its technical log usually says why.
failed.title: Some of the work failed
stages.title: Progress
forceStop.title: Force this job to stop?
forceStop.body: It still hasn't stopped since you cancelled it. Force stop ends it at once, without letting it finish what it is writing: an index it was building can be left half built, so run that job again afterwards.
earlierRun.title: Can't be stopped from here
earlierRun.body: An earlier run of Eidolon started this job, so this one can't stop it. It will finish on its own, or be marked interrupted.
note.running: It keeps running when you close this page.
note.stopping: It stops once it has finished what it is writing.
